title: Sebastian and the Cipher
author: Dominic Okonkwo
blurb: Mara Villalobos, an insurance investigator with a photographic memory, has spent ten years keeping the town's secrets filed and alphabetized. Then the town's beloved founder is exhumed and the coffin is empty — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must trap a killer who knows the case file better than the investigators do, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
